integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-8s] Cinematic timelapse transition. The scene begins exactly as <Picture 1>@图1. Over 8 seconds, the scene smoothly transitions until the final frame exactly matches <Picture 2>@图2. The lighting, color temperature, and atmosphere shift progressively from the first frame's quality to the last frame's — shadows lengthen and rotate, the sky tone transitions from day to night, and any lights or luminous elements in the scene activate progressively as appropriate to the transition. Ambient details respond naturally to the time-of-day shift. The camera is fixed throughout. The transition feels like a compressed timelapse of several hours. Every element changes smoothly and continuously — no cuts, no jumps. The final frame exactly matches <Picture 2>@图2.

overall_soundscape: Distant ambient sound that shifts character from daytime to nighttime — background activity fading, night insects or wind emerging as appropriate to the scene.

non_diegetic_music: A gentle ambient track that evolves from warm daytime acoustic tones to cooler, more mysterious electronic textures as night falls.
